column1: # Phonetic variant table (FR-LEX-4, technical design §9.1) — a versioned, bundled asset.
# Format: <spoken form> <TAB> <PhoneticUnit>. The spoken form is matched after normalising to
# lowercase with every non-alphanumeric character removed, so "x-ray", "x ray" and "xray" are
# one key. NATO, letter-name and legacy (WWII/ARRL) pronunciations all appear here so that
# AC-12 — three pronunciations of one callsign yield one result — holds structurally.
